intro: Pyrewood Shackles are enchanted restraints worn by the beleaguered inhabitants of Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest. Imbued with the strange magic of Archmage Arugal, these bands are linked to the eerie curse that transforms ordinary townsfolk into ravenous worgen once night falls.

p: The cursed village of Pyrewood holds an unsettling secret: by day, its residents carry on ordinary lives appearing as typical humans, but the setting sun twists them into feral Moonrage worgen. Archmage Arugal bound these villagers in enchanted shackles as part of his twisted experiments with worgen sorcery. Dalar Dawnweaver, an arcane researcher stationed at the Sepulcher for the Forsaken, studies these shackles to decode the enchantments driving this dual existence. By gathering and analyzing the lingering energy on the bands, Dawnweaver seeks a deeper understanding of Arugal's magic in hopes of unraveling the mad archmage's hold over the region.
